_meta.what: Static, machine-verified repository-control baseline for workflow actions, permissions, history, publisher environments and the exact post-rebase publication gate; not a penetration test or security certification.

limitations: This verifies committed repository and workflow text; it does not inspect GitHub account settings, MFA, branch protection, environment protection, token policy or hosted infrastructure.
No external penetration test, independent security audit, formal threat-model review or security certification has been completed.
A GitHub-hosted static site reduces server attack surface but does not eliminate supply-chain, repository-account, browser, dependency or data-integrity risk.
The post-rebase gate prefers refusing a scheduled publication over publishing an unverified candidate; it is an integrity control, not an availability SLA.
Action commit identities were resolved to the stated upstream releases, but this registry is not a substitute for ongoing dependency review and vulnerability monitoring.
